conversation_parts.body: Hi Bryn, I’m trying to reconcile the reserves for our latest batch of claims but the system isn’t pulling through the supplier payments correctly — any idea what might be causing that?
Thanks for reaching out, Gellin. Let me check the integrations on your account — sometimes a sync delay can cause mismatched payment data. Could you confirm which policyholders’ claims are affected?
It’s mostly the commercial property claims under policyholder ID C8821 — the ones we submitted last Tuesday. The payments show as pending but reserves aren’t updating.
Got it. I’ll run a manual sync for those claims and review the roles assigned to your team’s payment approvers. Should be resolved within the hour — I’ll send you a confirmation email.
Appreciate the quick help — you’ve saved us a headache before the monthly reporting deadline.
Happy to help, Gellin. Let us know if anything else comes up — we’re here to keep your claims workflow smooth.
